The projection source primitive then overlays probabilistic forecasts onto this base, enabling GSI to compute expected value distributions. The optimizer precedent provides a dual perspective: that of a CSV-driven system versus an API-dependent one, which informs GSE’s design choice between real-time data fetching and batch processing. These primitives form a triadic relationship where salary data constrains optimization, projections inform belief states, and precedent shapes implementation strategy. Failure modes include stale projections, incorrect API parsing, and unauthorized data scraping. The interplay of these elements defines a robust yet flexible framework for lineup construction under uncertainty.
